integrity: Analytic proof of each infinite-time limit; reproducibility program checks finite histories only. No external or independent scientific audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exact laws concern only the degree-stationary scalar projection on a homogeneous three-vertex path with independent uniform sampling and unequal leaf predispositions. Existing generic stochastic approximation establishes the broad normal/non-normal scaling regimes; full publication priority is not conclusively resolved.
title: Exact finite-time fluctuations and a non-Gaussian regime for three-person sampled-neighbor opinion learning
